Vision

A reusable starting point for building maintainable, requirement-traced projects with AI agents and humans working from the same playbook. The goal: code and analytics that stay readable and correct over the long run, built test-first with explicit approval gates so you can trust what ships.

Work-item trajectory

The dependency DAG from docs/requirements/work-items.csv, laid out left→right by dependency rank (a work item sits one column past its deepest hard predecessor). How this project is built

The method reference — the other tabs show project state; this one shows the process the state moves through. Data-derived where a canonical source exists (docs/gate, the spine registries, work-items.csv). A view — the process docs are the source of truth.

Current gate: G3 — derived from artifact states and cached to docs/gate (derive_gate.py); highlighted stages are the tiers this gate spans.

1 · Artifact lifecycle × gates

Each tier decomposes the one above it and is ratified through the gate it spans — the tiers (§3) and the gate bars (§4) live in project-trajectory/PROCESS.md. Counts are live from this repo's registries.

  1. Vision—one home (the README tag)
  2. SNG125 SN
  3. SRG1→G2110 SR · 110 verified
  4. LLR + architectureG2101 LLR
  5. TCG2→G3104 TC
  6. code + testsG3110 of 110 SR verified

2 · The resume loop

The managed agent_loop.py walk-away flow — the full contract is project-trajectory/PROCESS_OPTIONS.md “Unattended operation”. The dashed CRITIQUE phase is tier-conditional.

  1. read status
  2. PLAN
  3. BUILD
  4. REVIEW-A/B
  5. CRITIQUE
  6. INTEGRATE
  7. commit
  8. hook / gate
  9. repeat
  • DESIGN-CHECK — a review finding that indicts the design routes the next session to a design pass, not a re-build.
  • Page the human — nothing routable, or the declared gate policy requires a human act: the loop parks with the ask recorded in docs/status.md.

3 · Slices → phase → gates

A per-WI slice ends at the commit bar; a phase closes at the gate bar — the commit-bar-vs-gate-bar cadence lives in project-trajectory/PROCESS_OPTIONS.md “Trajectory / work-items layer”. Live from work-items.csv: 302 work items · 278 done.

  1. per-WI sliceone scoped work item; ends at the commit bar
  2. commit barthe per-commit suite + doc checks — every commit
  3. phase closea phase's slices batch to one re-attestation sitting
  4. gate barthe full check.py --gate run at phase close / advance
  5. CIruns the same bar on every push

4 · The working loops

Two circular flows close the method — how work enters (A) and how the human decides (B) — both entered by the same agent. Each stage links to its canonical home (status.md, work-items.csv, open-items.md, log.md); the loop structure is the method's, not this repo's data.
